title: W64 release and deployment reproducibility proof
purpose: Prove release packaging and deployment steps can be recreated from authority files without hidden local state.

P1_primary: Locate release packaging entrypoints, version manifests, and deployment descriptors.
Map release inputs to canonical authorities and generated package outputs.
Record environment assumptions and reproducibility prerequisites.
P2_reverse_pressure: Reject packaging steps that depend on untracked local state, stale Docker material, or old ABACUS version trees.
Detect deployment paths without authority lineage or rollback evidence.
Verify release metadata does not claim binaries or registries outside their receipts.
P3_receipt: Emit an exact-head release deployment receipt with package names, commands, inputs, and rollback boundary.
Require green release/deployment CI before readiness credit.
Declare any dependency-bound release step as blocked rather than promoted.

acceptance_gates: Every release output has source input lineage and command provenance.
Deployment descriptors are classified as active, dormant, or obsolete.
Rollback or non-deployable boundary is explicitly documented.
non_claims: Does not publish a formal GitHub release.
Does not alter protected main settings.
Does not claim deployment success without exact-head execution evidence.
